variants.headline: Home world raises its demands
variants.body: The home world has raised what it demands of the colony. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A larger claim on the colony
variants.body: The demands placed on the colony by the home world have increased. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Distant authority asks for more
variants.body: The home world is demanding more from {colony}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
